name: JoulWatt Technology
summary: Established in 2013 and headquartered in Hangzhou, China, JoulWatt Technology Co., Ltd. operates as a specialist in analog integrated circuit design. The company is actively involved in the research, development, and commercialization of integrated circuits, predominantly serving the Chinese market. Its extensive product portfolio includes a diverse range of power management chips, featuring AC-DC converters, DC-DC converters, battery management solutions, and linear power components. JoulWatt also provides signal chain chips, encompassing products for detection, interface, conversion, and testing. These advanced semiconductor offerings are widely implemented across various sectors, such as enterprise computing and storage systems, consumer electronic devices, telecommunications infrastructure, industrial applications, and other emerging fields.
